HOME & ONLINE TUITION · PURNEA

Find the right tutor for your child.
Get support beyond the first class.

Carefully selected home and online tutors in Purnea, backed by personalised learning plans and ongoing academic reviews.

Apply as a Tutor

A THOUGHTFUL BEGINNING

A good start. In three simple steps.
01
UNDERSTAND
Tell us what they need

Their class, subject and what feels difficult.

02
CONNECT
Find a tutor who fits

Explore assessed tutors and book a trial.

03
GROW
See them move forward

Follow each lesson and the next steps.

LEARNING STAGES

Every stage needs a different kind of support.

Start with the class group, then share subject, board, timing, mode and the exact learning need. Approved tutor availability is shown profile by profile.

01

UP TO CLASS 5

Foundation years

Build confidence in reading, numeracy, homework habits and the basics before gaps become stressful.

02

CLASSES 6-8

Concept building

Strengthen subject understanding, regular practice and doubt clearing as school topics become deeper.

03

CLASSES 9-10

Board preparation

Focus on syllabus coverage, weak chapters, revision rhythm and exam confidence for board years.

04

CLASSES 11-12

Senior secondary

Look for focused support in advanced subjects, board goals and preparation for the next academic step.

YOUR CHILD'S REQUIREMENT

Share the details that make matching useful.

The best tutor suggestion starts with a clear picture of your child, not just a subject name. Add the academic and practical details once, then the team can review tutor fit with better context.

Find a Tutor
Class, subject and board

The level, curriculum and topic area your child needs help with.

Goal and weak areas

Exam preparation, concept gaps, homework support or confidence building.

Mode, locality and timing

Home or online preference, nearby area for home tuition, and workable time windows.

Language and learning style

Preferred teaching language and anything that helps the tutor support your child well.

MORE THAN A SINGLE LESSON

Tutors may change.
Progress stays.

Your child’s learning plan, lesson notes and next steps stay together. So a new tutor can pick up where they left off.

Explore our academic approach

AN ILLUSTRATIVE LEARNING RECORD

Every next step has a starting point.
